title: Prototyping Theories with ChatGPT: Experiment with the Technology Acceptance Model

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the demographic distribution of ChatGPT-generated student samples to observe overrepresentation (e.g., generating more female students) and measuring statistically significant differences in theoretical construct responses between the simulated male and female personas.

Evaluating the distribution of background variables in the generated student personas (such as ChatGPT experience, AR experience, and English ability) and observing how a skew towards higher experience levels influences the resulting construct response scores.
